## Catch the Latest Updates

Your browser does not support the video tag.
July 24, 2024

**AGEL’s world's largest renewable energy plant at Khavda, Gujarat begins wind energy generation
with initial 250 MW, enhancing Khavda’s operational capacity to 2,250 MW including solar.**

Jul 01, 2026

** Adani Green Energy surpasses 20 GW operational capacity, equals ~14% of India’s utility-scale
solar and ~12% of utility solar-wind capacity**

[Read more][111]
Jun 27, 2026

**Sagar Adani calls for faster electrification as Adani Green convenes global energy dialogue at
London's Science Museum**

[Read more][112]
May 26, 2026

**Adani Green Energy commissions the world's largest single-location battery energy storage system*
of 3.37 GWh; strengthens reliable and clean power access**

[Read more][113]
[View all][114]

## Message From the Leadership

## Vneet Jaain

Managing Director
Adani Green Energy Ltd

"We are committed to create a greener future. Our vision is to have a portfolio of 50 GW of RE
capacity by 2030."

## Ashish Khanna

Chief Executive Officer
Adani Green Energy Ltd

"AGEL is the largest renewable power producer in India and we are committed to lead adoption of
affordable clean energy in the country."

## Sustainability and Us

**Sustainability Report**

Leading to future powered by renewable energy. Our efforts are focused on pursuing sustainable
practices across operations.

[Download Report][115]

**Water Stewardship**

We adopt sustainable techniques such as waterless robotic module cleaning systems to limit our water
footprint

[Read more][116]

**Corporate Social Responsibility**

Adani Foundation focused on CSR, sustainability and community outreach facilitates our
transformative endeavours

[Read more][117]

## Investor Corner

[May 2026 Investor Presentation][119]

## what you need

Decarbonising heavy industry is a complex challenge. What will work on your site? Will it reduce
emissions on the scale you need and be cost-effective? Can it be done in time to meet your targets?

**The answer is simple. **

With years of experience working with leading industrial companies, we know exactly what you need -
and we have the space-saving modular solutions to make it happen.

## We have the answers

Our technology is optimised for industrial environments where space is tight and efficiency is a
priority. Need a solution that slots into the smallest of on-site spaces? You’ve got it. Keen to
save on plant downtime?

**No problem. **

Looking to avoid a lengthy permitting process? So are we. Want advanced heat integration? We do that
too. Our technology is the answer.

## Trusted

From key customers to investors, we partner with leading global companies.
Our reputation as a leading pioneer is built on 15 years of proven innovation in designing, building
and operating industrial carbon capture systems.

We are revolutionising the carbon capture sector with one of the strongest patent portfolios.
Innovation is in our DNA, with over 131 active patent assets across 24 patent families, covering
over 30 countries. Our journey started with innovative solvents; we are now at the forefront of next
generation modular, carbon capture technology.

Accelerating the deployment of CCUS is vital to reach net zero by 2050.
That’s why our focus is on driving down the cost of carbon capture with technologies that deliver
substantial savings and efficiencies - enabling you to achieve your carbon reduction goals, without
compromising your bottom line.

Our technology is already making a difference in 50 sites across the world.
Our vision is to deliver industrial decarbonisation on a gigatonne scale through innovative
technology that mitigates the impact of climate change. We’ve cumulatively captured more than 2.8m
tonnes of CO2.

emissions on the scale you need and be cost-effective? Can it be done in time to meet your targets?

**The answer is simple. **

With years of experience working with leading industrial companies, we know exactly what you need -
and we have the space-saving modular solutions to make it happen.

Our technology is optimised for industrial environments where space is tight and efficiency is a
priority. Need a solution that slots into the smallest of on-site spaces? You’ve got it. Keen to
save on plant downtime?

**No problem. **

Looking to avoid a lengthy permitting process? So are we. Want advanced heat integration? We do that

generation modular, carbon capture technology.

## Paving India's path to progress as an energy solution company

## Our heritage, our legacy

 

In 1915, in the far-out hinterland of rural Maharashtra, the spark of Tata Power flickered to life.
Rooted in the vision of - Jamsetji Tata, the energy company in India set about on a journey fueled
by the idea of not just providing electricity but igniting a nation's potential. Over the years, we
have become one of the leading integrated energy solutions company in India that is quite adept at
pushing boundaries to power progress at scale. Our legacy spans generations. Be it the gushing
waters of our pioneering hydroelectric projects, the sprawling network of modern power plants, or
the dream to change the landscape with a focus on renewable energy solutions with wind energy and
solar energy, we have been orchestrating a symphony of progress. However, beyond the gleaming
history lies a story that beats with the heart of India itself. It is a story of lives empowered,
communities uplifted, and dreams lighted. As a vanguard of change and progress, we continue to
embody the spirit of innovation with an unwavering dedication to excellence, safety, and customer
satisfaction. After all, it is this promise that has earned us your trust as a leader in India’s
growth story

## Shaping the next-gen energy solutions

 

A mere spark is now an unstoppable force driving the transformation of next-gen energy solutions in
India. The leadership spirit of Tata Power, a power company in India, is the catalyst for
innovation, propelling the company to the forefront of the energy sector. In the grand tapestry of
our journey, cutting-edge solar energy, wind energy, hydroelectric energy, and conventional
technologies are driving efficient, eco-friendly power generation. Tata Power is now pioneering a
new paradigm. From empowering smart consumers with integrated solutions to revolutionizing mobility
and lifestyle, our vision fuels multi-dimensional growth. What truly sets us apart is our relentless
commitment to sustainability. 'Sustainable is Attainable' isn't just a slogan—it is our ethos. We
are spearheading the transition to clean energy solutions, and we would love for you to join us in
embracing a brighter, greener tomorrow

## Paving India's path to progress as an energy solution company

## Our heritage, our legacy

 

In 1915, in the far-out hinterland of rural Maharashtra, the spark of Tata Power flickered to life.
Rooted in the vision of - Jamsetji Tata, the energy company in India set about on a journey fueled
by the idea of not just providing electricity but igniting a nation's potential. Over the years, we
have become one of the leading integrated energy solutions company in India that is quite adept at
pushing boundaries to power progress at scale. Our legacy spans generations. Be it the gushing
waters of our pioneering hydroelectric projects, the sprawling network of modern power plants, or
the dream to change the landscape with a focus on renewable energy solutions with wind energy and
solar energy, we have been orchestrating a symphony of progress. However, beyond the gleaming
history lies a story that beats with the heart of India itself. It is a story of lives empowered,
communities uplifted, and dreams lighted. As a vanguard of change and progress, we continue to
embody the spirit of innovation with an unwavering dedication to excellence, safety, and customer
satisfaction. After all, it is this promise that has earned us your trust as a leader in India’s
growth story

## Shaping the next-gen energy solutions

 

A mere spark is now an unstoppable force driving the transformation of next-gen energy solutions in
India. The leadership spirit of Tata Power, a power company in India, is the catalyst for
innovation, propelling the company to the forefront of the energy sector. In the grand tapestry of
our journey, cutting-edge solar energy, wind energy, hydroelectric energy, and conventional
technologies are driving efficient, eco-friendly power generation. Tata Power is now pioneering a
new paradigm. From empowering smart consumers with integrated solutions to revolutionizing mobility
and lifestyle, our vision fuels multi-dimensional growth. What truly sets us apart is our relentless
commitment to sustainability. 'Sustainable is Attainable' isn't just a slogan—it is our ethos. We
are spearheading the transition to clean energy solutions, and we would love for you to join us in
embracing a brighter, greener tomorrow

and a data-driven approach.

##### Digital Customer Onboarding

insights and easy management are few perks that come with Digital Customer Onboarding.

### NETWORK AS A SERVICE

Creating a Data Rich India

##### 01
##### Rural Survey

It's critical to know what, how and why the 69% of India is doing. Get real insights from rural
India to make effective decisions about your product, expansion strategy, ROI and what not.

##### 02
##### App Marketing

It's tricky, time consuming, and sometimes a failure when an app is not marketed amongst its target
audience. With us, you are now a call away from your audience. We offer frugal ways to get verified
sign-ups through our extended reach.

##### 03
##### Data Collection

Data is All-Mighty in today's digital world. Refined and bigger the data set, more precise and
accurate are the decisions you take. Collect the data from more than 11k pin codes and be ready to
wear a crown in your sector.

##### 04
##### GTM (Go-to-Market)

Anaxee’s GTM (Go-to-Market) strategy has helped many businesses increase their sales and reach. By
mapping, profiling, and directly taking orders from shops in targeted locations, companies gain
valuable insights about retailers and expand their presence effectively.

##### 05
##### Climate/Carbon Credit Projects

Anaxee combines technology with its vast Digital Runner network to deliver efficient and impactful
climate and carbon projects. Whether it’s tree-counting, polygon mapping, cookstove distribution, or
biochar initiatives, Anaxee ensures transparency, integrity, and effectiveness using advanced tools
and a data-driven approach.

##### 06
##### Digital Customer Onboarding

When your customers gets on-boarded on your digital platform, things start changing. Clarity,
insights and easy management are few perks that come with Digital Customer Onboarding.

### Story of our vision & mission

Smiling faces of India

The network of 40K+ people whom we call "Digital Runners" are bringing out the change by marking
presence of Anaxee even in the remotest parts of India.

Their pride stories of enriching their own lives and people around them, keeps us going and work
harder.

Project Swaraksha came to the rescue, providing digital assistance using Digital Runners +
Technology. We thank Meta (aka Facebook) for covering our story in such a beautiful manner. Please
go through this 9 mins Documentary made by National Film Award-winning producer, Priyanka More on
Project Swaraksha and Anaxee.


Govind Agrawal, CEO Anaxee Digital Runners Private Limited was invited as a Speaker at StartUps and
IT Seminar and Exhibition today under the seven-day long celebration of 'Indore Gourav Divas' today
alongwith Sawan S Laddha, Mayur Sethi, Arti Gupta Agrawal, Saloni Sethi, and MSME dept.

Your change agents in rural India. Empowering thousands of rural youth across India. Thank you,
Facebook (Meta). For telling our story in such a beautiful manner!

Under Project Swaraksha, around 20,000 Digital Runners got united and counseled 2.6 million people.
So far we have helped in the vaccination of 1.8 million rural citizens.

offering independent certification services. Our work ensures compliance, credibility, and market
access for clients globally. We are offering certification services under the following schemes:

Certification for sustainable fuels and renewable feedstocks under:
* ISCC CORSIA — ISCC CORSIA – ICAO-compliant certification for SAF.

# Ready for the future?

We are one of the world’s leading Validation Verification Body (VVB) and our credentials speak for
themselves. We deliver confident, trusted, and verifiable solutions for your most demanding
challenges.

[ Get Started ][36]

## A team of experienced, professional and knowledgeable people.

Carbon Check (India) Pvt. Ltd (CCIPL) is a globally recognized organization that has validated and
verified greenhouse gas (GHG) projects worldwide. Our commitment lies in delivering exceptional
third-party assurance, training, and knowledge services in the realm of climate change and
sustainability on a global scale, ensuring impartial and competent support.

✓

Globally certified: First worldwide Designated Operational Entity under Article 6.4 of the Paris
Agreement.

⬡

Projects in: Renewable Energy, Oil & Gas, Power, Transport, Agriculture, Forestry, Mining, Telecom,
Banking, Livestock, Chemicals & more

★

2,000+ GHG & sustainability projects across 100+ countries, on 6 continents.

📈

A team of experienced professionals in climate change, carbon markets & sustainability.

[Sustainability]
Certification · ISO/IEC 17065

## ISCC CORSIA Certification

Carbon Check is now operating as Certification Body ISO/IEC 17065 (Product Certification), and
offering independent certification services. Our work ensures compliance, credibility, and market
access for clients globally. We are offering certification services under the following schemes:

### ISCC CORSIA Certification

Certification for sustainable fuels and renewable feedstocks under:
* ISCC CORSIA — ISCC CORSIA – ICAO-compliant certification for SAF.

## Our Global Accreditations

Accreditation is vital for ensuring the impartiality and competence of validation bodies. Carbon
Check is recognized by the world's leading environmental and carbon standards.
